comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A red-name Ganador, he can be challenged when the World Clock is set to the 15th Century's third through fifth periods, or if one equips Adept of Ages (15th Century-P.3) / Adept of Ages (15th Century-P.4) / Adept of Ages (15th Century-P.5) titles or Age effect (15th century) EX Effect equipment. Additionally, you must have also defeated Kemal Reis once -- see details on the comment section of that page.

Can potentially drop the following when defeated:

Custom Large 2 decked Row Boat
Nocturnal Metal Paneling (removed on Maris)
Turkish Admiral Outfit
Aide Training (removed on Maris)
Praise to the Brave
Cannonsmith's Forging Tools
Flag of Ottoman Empire (removed on Maris)

Use ケマル・レイス with Ctrl-F to locate his Ganador map on the following page:

66noa.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-44.html

He'll be the red dot.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Ganador/List

wiki:
Difficulty: Red
Requirements:

World Clock Availability: 15th Century, periods 3-5
** If the World Clock is set to a different era, equipping Adept of Ages (15th Century-P.3) / Adept of Ages (15th Century-P.4) / Adept of Ages (15th Century-P.5) titles OR Age effect (15th century) EX item is the only way to access this Ganador!

Additionally:

1. Defeat Grimani OR Khalil Pasha
2. Defeat Kemal Reis

Ganador location (red dot):


Drop List:

Custom Large 2 decked Row Boat
Large Storm Sail
Turkish Admiral Outfit
Cannonsmith's Forging Tools
